plan.title: AD lesional vs control hallmark GSEA (Python)
plan.analytical_narrative:
The research question asks only which hallmark pathways are enriched in the treated (AD lesional) vs control contrast, and the DESeq2 results table for exactly that contrast is already provided (/data/inputs/results/de_results.csv, 12000 genes x 8 columns, gene symbols, base_mean, log2_fold_change, lfcSE/stat/pvalue/padj family). So no differential expression re-run is planned; the analysis starts from the existing results as the user asked.

T1S1 validates and prepares the ranking: it reads de_results.csv, confirms which columns are present (in particular the Wald statistic column and padj), reports how many of the 12000 genes carry a usable statistic and how many are NA (DESeq2 sets p to NA for Cook's-distance outliers at n=6 per group, and independent filtering sets padj to NA), harmonizes gene symbols to HGNC, resolves ties and duplicates, and writes a single full ranked list of every tested gene. Ranking metric: the Wald statistic (`stat`). That is a stated choice on a disputed point — it is signed and scaled by the standard error, so it does not inherit the noise of an unshrunken fold change from a low-count gene, and it does not tie at the top the way a signed p-value does. If the results table carries no `stat` column, the fallback is sign(log2_fold_change) * -log10(pvalue), and the step must report which metric it used. The list is NOT thresholded — every tested gene goes in, since the enrichment statistic depends on the position of set members across the whole ranking.

T2S1 runs the preranked GSEA in Python (gseapy.prerank, since the user requires Python and gseapy 1.3.1 is installed) against the MSigDB human hallmark collection staged in the reference store (50 HALLMARK_* sets, HGNC symbols, MSigDB 2026.1). Set size window 15-500 after intersection with the tested genes; BH adjustment; fixed seed. Because hallmark sets overlap (e.g. TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB, INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE, IL6_JAK_STAT3, INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE share many genes and are all plausible in AD lesional skin), significant sets are grouped by leading-edge overlap and one representative per group is reported, with the full table kept as a supplement.

T2S2 is a confirmatory second collection — Reactome is not staged here, but WikiPathways human and MSigDB GO BP are, so the same ranked list is re-tested against those to resolve a broad hallmark hit onto a named pathway. This step is annotation, not the answer: if the collection is missing at run time it reports that and the hallmark result stands.

T1S3 assembles the report: the ranked hallmark table with NES, p, padj and leading-edge genes per significant set; the collection name and version; the rank metric; the universe (the tested genes of the supplied DESeq2 table); the size window; the count of genes with NA statistics; the sample_01 low-depth caveat carried forward as a limitation on the upstream DE table this analysis inherits and did not re-derive; and the reproducibility record. Enrichment results are method-dependent and are reported as hypotheses, not proven mechanism.

Every script is Python per the user constraint; no R is used anywhere in the plan.
